summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Part 2 (product×country SEO template) and the full HS directory (5,606 codes). 20/21 pytest cases passing (one transient 502 flake on hs-directory total count — endpoint functionally verified by other tests in the same run). All critical acceptance criteria met: HS directory total=5606 with no duplicates and chapter/prefix search; HS pickers at /tools/hsn-finder, /tools/duty-calculator and /buyers work at both 1920x4000 and 390x844 (trigger/search/panel/option-091030/clear all operational, trigger label updates to 'HS 091030 — Turmeric (curcuma)', clear restores placeholder, buyers page re-runs search); /export/basmati-rice/to/germany renders H1, epc-answer with HS 100630, epc-snapshot, epc-duty (with SOURCE/AS OF year), epc-demand (world + Germany + top importers), epc-buyers real counts (5,280 records, 113 matches, 112 sector matches), epc-faq with 8 items (epc-faq-0..7), epc-actions right rail, FAQPage + Breadcrumb + WebPage JSON-LD; data-sufficiency gate works: /export/agarbatti/to/bahrain shows epc-thin-notice and robots='noindex, nofollow'; /export/agarbatti/to/{uae,saudi-arabia} show epc-buyers-waitlist, agarbatti/germany shows real buyer counts (no waitlist panel); unknown slugs render epc-error with noindex; exactly one meta robots and exactly one canonical on every page checked (/, /tools, /buyers, /export/basmati-rice/to/germany, bahrain, uae, saudi, agarbatti/germany, unknown slug); sitemap.xml valid, contains 27 /export URLs, agarbatti/bahrain correctly absent; Part 1 regression (catalogue, matrix filtered, ping-log admin-only) still green; general regression (countries=250, duty lookup 200, buyers meta total=27388) all green.
critical_code_review_comments: ExportProductCountry page is content-rich and well-structured — honest buyer panel outside Europe behaves exactly per spec. No issues observed.
Shared HsCodePicker reused across 3 pages with consistent testIds — good DRY. Keyboard navigation not explicitly tested; defer to future UI regression if needed.

GET /api/trade-intel/hs-directory?limit=9999 responds 422 (hard reject) instead of silently capping to 500. Spec said 'capped at 500' — current behaviour is stricter but acceptable; just note the convention mismatch with other paginated endpoints.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest covers hs-directory (count/duplicates/search/chapter/paging), hs-chapters, hs-search, seo page-data for basmati/germany + agarbatti/bahrain + agarbatti/uae + agarbatti/germany + unknown slug, sitemap integrity, Part 1 regressions, and general regressions. Playwright verified pickers on 3 pages at 2 viewports and meta/canonical uniqueness on 9 pages. Transient 502 on /api/trade-intel/hs-directory?limit=1 was seen once — endpoint otherwise stable; worth a retry wrapper if flakes continue. Unfiltered /api/seo/matrix without product+region params returns non-JSON/HTML within our timeout window — always pass product+region filters.
